collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The vote for a new leader was very close, and the loser wants it held again: hold it again, or accept the result.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The village chose its new {@chief} by dropping shells in baskets, and (subject) lost by two shells. Now (subject) says three villagers dropped their shells twice, and wants the vote held again. (friend), who won, says (subject) is a sore loser. What should the village do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village holds the vote again, with someone watching every basket. (friend) wins again, by six shells this time. (subject) accepts it, and shakes (friend)'s hand. (friend) is gracious, mostly.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village decides the result stands. (subject) does not accept it, and says so at every gathering for a season. Then (subject.he/she) gets tired, and stops. (friend) is a decent {@chief}. (subject) never quite forgives the two shells.
